title: Loop Halting and Output
statement: Let $n$ and $i$ be natural numbers. For every pair of natural numbers $d,k$ such that $k+d=n$ and $k\le i$, the specified machine, on input encoding the unary string of length $n$ paired with the binary expansion of $i$, halts with output true exactly when $i<n$. It starts in state $\mathrm{test}$ with its two registers equal to $k$ and $2k$, respectively, and no output; at every time strictly before halting, its configuration satisfies the stated invariant $G$.
